title: The Ladies Man
description: A late-night radio host and self-described Casanova (Tim Meadows) searches for a lost love when he receives an unsigned letter boasting of her wealth.

title: Senseless
description: An experimental drug wreaks havoc upon a hardworking college student (Marlon Wayans) by altering his senses.

title: Harlem Nights
description: Business partners resisting a white mobster trying to take over their nightclub in the 1930s Harlem.

title: The Honeymooners
description: New York bus driver Ralph Kramden and pal Ed Norton test their wives' patience with moneymaking schemes that end in failure.

title: Boomerang
description: A Manhattan playboy (Eddie Murphy) gets a new corporate boss (Robin Givens), and she treats him the way he has always treated women.

title: Vampire in Brooklyn
description: A Caribbean vampire seeks the half-vampire, half-human New York homicide detective destined to be his bride.

title: Pootie Tang
description: Although he speaks an indecipherable language, a superhero (Lance Crouther) protects children from a mogul (Jennifer Coolidge) who encourages smoking, drinking and eating fast food.

title: Tropic Thunder
description: A pampered actor and his co-stars must become actual soldiers when the war movie they are filming in Southeast Asia turns into the real thing.

title: Necessary Roughness
description: An over-30 ex-quarterback (Scott Bakula) gets to play as a freshman on a wild-card team at a Texas college.

title: Bad News Bears
description: A single mother (Marcia Gay Harden) recruits a former baseball player (Billy Bob Thornton) to coach a ragtag team of misfit Little Leaguers.

title: Coneheads
description: Stranded on Earth, aliens Beldar and Prymaat of Remulak try suburbia with their teenage daughter, Connie.

title: Evolution
description: Chaos ensues when a meteor hits the Earth carrying alien life forms that give new meaning to the term survival of the fittest.

title: The Tuxedo
description: A chauffeur (Jackie Chan) embarks on a covert mission after a tuxedo from a secret agent (Jason Isaacs) gives him extraordinary abilities.

title: Kingpin
description: A one-handed salesman, an Amish farm boy and a pretty con artist pull bowling scams to get to a $1 million tournament in Reno.

description: Three college roommates join a bus full of sexy models to compete in the National Beer Pong Tournament.
